instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-16_input.step. Build and fuse a semicircular pipe clamp on the 130 x 60 x 10 mm base plate. The clamp arch runs along X from 25 to 105, has centerline Y=30 and spring-line center Z=10, outside radius 22 mm and inside radius 14 mm; keep only the upper half of the arch above the base. Add front and rear ear pads spanning X=25..105, Y=0..12 and Y=48..60, Z=10..18. Cut a 6 mm diameter through hole through the front ear along Y at X=45, Z=14, and another through the rear ear at X=85, Z=14. The result must be one fused solid. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-16_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
